title: Countable coproduct preservation for flat comparison functors
statement: Let f:Z -> Y be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], and assume the recorded tensorPullback f is additive [def-pc-module-pullback]. Both functors L = DerivedCategory.Qh followed by derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback] and G = mapHomotopyCategory(tensorPullback f) followed by DerivedCategory.Qh preserve coproducts indexed by Nat in the homotopy category of O_Y-module cochain complexes. No flatness, boundedness, properness, Noetherian condition or comparison family is assumed.

proof.text: First prove that the quotient cofan of any termwise coproduct of complexes is colimiting: lift each morphism by fullness of the quotient, assemble chain maps by Sigma.desc, and use coproduct_homotopy to assemble homotopies and prove uniqueness. Every homotopy object has a representative, so preservation by quotient followed by a functor implies preservation by that functor on discrete diagrams; transport along the representative equalities. These are private fully proved helpers.

For index I : Type u, derivedAmbientDirectSumsCofan with identity representative isomorphisms gives preservation by Q. Install derivedPullback as a left adjoint using nonempty_derivedPullbackAdjunction. Whisker quotientCompQhIso by derivedPullback and apply the preceding helper. For the termwise side obtain the recorded exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction and install its tensorPullback adjunction, lift preservation to complexes, and use mapHomotopyCategoryFactors and quotientCompQhIso to identify quotient followed by G with complex tensorPullback followed by Q on Z. Apply the same helper. Work at I = ULift Nat and transport both preservation instances along the discrete equivalence with Nat.
